name: Studio Nicholson

prices.note: Men's T-shirts collection, T-shirts only (jersey tops and polos excluded): Bric T-Shirt and Lay T-Shirt £95, Piu T-Shirt £110. All regular price. Store default currency GBP; USD at ECB 2026-10-28 (GBP 0.83785, USD 1.1133). US checkout prices through Global-E include duties and may differ.

notes: Shipping: US free on baskets over $100, else $10 Air Express; 'Duties are included in the prices of our products, tax will be calculated at checkout.' Canada free over CA$500, Australia free over A$500. UK free over £150.
Returns: within 14 days of receipt; international returns £10, deducted from the refund.

About: launched 2010 by founder and creative director Nick Wakeman; 'a no-nonsense clothing brand that revolves around a fabric-first approach'; stores in London, Tokyo, Kyoto and Seoul. hq_country GB inferred from the London store and GBP default store; HQ not stated.
